page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text (a Latin dictionary). Running head "EV." centred at top; page number "251" at top right. No margin notes of substance; faint show-through from the facing page in the margins is ignored. Text is set in one column from top to bottom.

main_text.p: Eventus non prospicere stultum est] Eventus stultorum magister.
Evertere aliquid] Subvertere decretum, Salust. Transvertere consilia alicujus, Firm. Explantat ventus arbores, Col.

Evertere urbem] Excidere urbes hostium. Delere & perdere. Exstinguere urbem, Tac. Expugnare oppidum, Plaut. Dare excidioni, Liv. Vertere arces, Virg. Convellere statum civitatis, Cic. Subruere arces, Propert. Eruere urbem, Virg.

Euge!] Evox. Io! Plaut. Evohe, Ovid. Evæ, Catul. Benè factum, macte. Rectè. Præclare, Cic. Optimum est. Patrone salve! Nunc places. Ædepol. Mortalem graphicum! Plaut. Laudo. Vir es. Virum te judico, Ter. Euge beate! Mart. Tanto fortior, tanto felicior, Sen. Io Pæan! Ovid. Vid. Benè.
Evidens] Probabilis, Cic. Authenticus, Vlp. Authenticæ rationes. Argumento patet, Quint. Explicitus locus, Cic.
Evidenter] Liquidè. Liquentius, Gell. Perspicuum, Cic. Vid. Clarè.
Evigilare] Expergisci, Virg. Expergefieri, Suet. Excita juventus, Ovid. Excutior somno, Virg. pro, Excutio somnum. Somnus me reliquit.

Evirare] Castrare, Claud. Eunuchare se, Varr. Eunuchum se facere, Iuv. Adimere virilitatem, Tacit. Excidere virilitatem, Quint. Eunuchare, Hieron. Emasculare, Serv. Moecho adimere abdomen, Plaut. Onus inguinis auferre, Ovid. Demetere ferro caudam salacem, Hor.

Eviratus] Exsectus ab aliquo, Cic. Gallus, Quint. Præcisus, Lampr. Spoliatus viro. Exmas, Arnob. Ademptæ virilitatis homo, Tac. Excisâ virilitate puer, Quint. Semivir, Iuv. Semimas, Varr. Spado, Plin. Deliaci manu recisus, Petron. Eunuchus, Iuv. Desperatio barbæ, Id. Castratus hæres. Ambiguus mas, Claud. Vir non vir.
Evitare] Evadere ex periculo. Evitare dolorem. Exire ærumnâ. Vitare fabulam. Elabi suspicione, è, ex, de manibus

page.notes: The last line of the page is partly overlapped by the faint catchword/ghost text "Evitare... inros, Cas..." at the bottom edge; only the clearly printed words are given. The word "Evitare" entry's last line continues onto the following page ("manibus" appears at the right, set slightly lower, and may be a catchword). Spellings such as "Everrere", "Eviratus", "Excisâ" and "Subruere" are as printed.
